Thanks for the call today, Marissa — that was helpful. A couple quick follow-ups from our side:

- We confirmed internal stakeholders: Ava (data) will own dataset prep and Jon (infra) will own cluster/network checks.
- Success criteria: we want to validate latency < 200ms p50 on our 4k token prompts and end-to-end throughput of 40 reqs/min at 8 concurrent users.
- Security asks: a brief checklist (SOC2 scope items) and an infrastructure diagram so we can start the procurement review.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 17:03:00 -08:00

Samir — great to sync. Draft POC plan attached (ClarityAI_POC_SuccessCriteria_v2.xlsx) and a short infra checklist (redwood_poc_infra_checklist.pdf). High level summary below and proposed owners/timeline.

POC objective:
- Validate model performance (latency & quality) and integration fit for Clarity AI product flows.

Success criteria (as discussed):
- Latency: p50 < 200ms for 4k token prompts (measured from API accept -> final token).
- Throughput: sustain 40 reqs/min with 8 concurrent users (end-to-end).
- Quality: match baseline generation score >= 0.85 on your eval set (sheet 'Eval Metrics').
- Operational: no critical security blockers in checklist; documented audit logs for request/response floor.

Proposed timeline (2-week trial, aiming to start Mon Mar 2):
- Week 0 (Mon Mar 2): infra validation + test dataset upload (owner: Jon).
- Week 1 (Mar 3–6): initial runs, latency tuning, and batching configuration (owners: Lauren + Jon).
- Week 2 (Mar 9–13): quality eval, final tuning, handover meeting and success review (owners: Marissa + Samir).

Action owners:
- Clarity AI: Ava (data) — prepare eval set; Jon (infra) — network & infra checklist.
- Redwood: Lauren — SE support & config; Rishi — performance tuning; Marissa — PM and final review.

Attachments: ClarityAI_POC_SuccessCriteria_v2.xlsx, redwood_poc_infra_checklist.pdf

Let us know if you want to adjust metrics — otherwise I'll block the kickoff for Mon Mar 2 and send calendar invites.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Jon — thanks. Short answers below and I'll follow up with the infra sheet updated with endpoints.

- Egress: Redwood uses a small set of public egress endpoints; full IP ranges attached in redwood_poc_infra_checklist.pdf (page 2). If you prefer allowlisting via DNS, we support that as well.
- Auth: short-lived tokens are supported. Default TTL is 1 hour; we can accept your broker if it issues tokens via JWT. Lauren — please confirm if we need to provide a refresh endpoint sample.

Rishi and Lauren are copied to handle the tech call Friday if helpful.

Thanks — I'll provision a sandbox key and send the invite for Mon kickoff.

Marissa

Subject: POC Week 1 status & next steps (Clarity AI)

Hi Samir/Ava/Jon — kicking off the weekly status thread. Short update from Redwood and asks for this week: 

Status (Day 1):
- Sandbox API key provisioned and shared to Jon (attached in secure DocuSign/Drive link).
- Initial smoke tests: p50 latency ~ 230ms on 4k prompts (no batching) — Rishi starting perf tuning today.
- Eval dataset successfully uploaded by Ava; Lauren beginning run config.

This week's asks (owners):
- Jon: allowlist IPs or confirm DNS allowlist method by Wed Mar 4.
- Ava: quick sanity check on eval set labels and a sample of 50 prompts by Wed Mar 4.
- Redwood (Rishi): run with batching (size 4) and report p50/p95 by Fri Mar 6.

Next checkpoint: end-of-week sync Fri Mar 6 at 10:00 PT — I'll send calendar invite. If anything blocks the onboarding, flag in this thread.

Attachments referenced: redwood_poc_infra_checklist.pdf

Best,
Marissa

Thanks Marissa — quick progress update:

- IP allowlist: we'll do DNS allowlist; Jon should post the FQDN by EOD today.
- Eval set: sanity check done, I removed ~12 duplicate prompts and uploaded the sample-of-50 to the shared Drive link — see folder.
- Performance: noted the initial p50 ~230ms. We'll check Fri after your batching run.

One question: for the quality eval, can you confirm the metric calculation (sheet 'Eval Metrics' in the xlsx)? Specifically how you compute the baseline score and whether the matching uses embedding similarity or token-level overlap.

If you can confirm the metric details I can run a parallel check on our side.

Thanks,
Ava
Data Lead, Clarity AI
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC Week 1 status & next steps (Clarity AI)

Ava — thanks for the quick turn. Short answers on metrics:

- Baseline score: we compute an average similarity score across your eval set using embedding cosine similarity (column 'EmbSim'). The 'match' threshold is set at 0.78 by default; the workbook shows the parameter and a sample calculation on row 12.
- We also include a token-overlap column for secondary diagnostics but the primary quality signal is embedding similarity.

I'll attach a short README sheet in the workbook explaining the calc and will post the formula as plain text in the Drive link.

See you at the sync on Fri.

Marissa
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
